findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_products, quote_basket, prepare_checkout · Public sink: quote_basket, prepare_checkout · Destructive: search_products, quote_basket.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_products, quote_basket, prepare_checkout · Public sink: quote_basket, prepare_checkout · Destructive: search_products, quote_basket

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
